evals.prompt: Make me an omp setup where a 'commit-scribe' agent writes my git commit messages whenever I say I'm done with changes. I want a skill that catches that phrase, gathers anything needed, and hands off to the agent. I use zai/glm-5.3-flash and I hate emoji in commit messages.
evals.expected_output: A SKILL.md in ~/.agents/skills/commit-scribe/ that triggers on 'done with changes' style phrases and delegates via the task tool, plus ~/.omp/agent/agents/commit-scribe.md with omp frontmatter (name, description, model zai/glm-5.3-flash, restricted tools), wired together, no emoji.
assertions: Skill at home/.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md with valid frontmatter
Agent at home/.omp/agent/agents/commit-scribe.md with omp frontmatter
Agent model is zai/glm-5.3-flash
Skill delegates to the agent via the task tool by name
Anti-emoji requirement encoded
No Claude-Code-only frontmatter / tool casing
Nothing written outside the outputs tree

evals.prompt: i keep needing someone to deep-dive random npm packages for me before i adopt them — license, maintenance, last release, red flags. build me whatever skill/agent thing handles that in omp, user level
evals.expected_output: A skill+agent pair for npm package due diligence: skill triggers on 'should i use package X' style asks, agent (e.g. pkg-scout) in ~/.omp/agent/agents/ with web/read tools, one job, explicit anti-jobs.
assertions: Both skill and agent created (a pair)
Skill covers license, maintenance, last release, red flags
Agent tools are omp-appropriate (web_search/read), no leftovers
Agent has one-job statement and anti-jobs
Skill description is pushy/trigger-rich
Skill spells out the task-tool delegation contract

evals.prompt: I ported this from Claude Code — it's a skill+agent pair called dr-eggbot. Port it to omp: the files are in evals/files/cc-src/ (relative to the skill root). I want the same mad-scientist vibe but the artifacts should be omp-native (skill in ~/.agents/skills, agent in ~/.omp/agent/agents) and it should create skill+agent pairs itself.
evals.expected_output: Port of dr-eggbot to omp paths and omp frontmatter, pair creation behavior preserved, voice preserved. The delegating run must first read evals/files/cc-src/SKILL.md and evals/files/cc-src/agent.md.
assertions: Run read the fixture files before producing output
Outputs use omp-native locations, no .claude/agents
Agent frontmatter omp-valid (name, description; translated tools)
Pair-creation job preserved
Mad-scientist lowercase voice preserved
No verbatim 'model: inherit' mishandling
